newsitem.title: USA: S. Calif. water district okays 1997 water payments.
newsitem.headline: S. Calif. water district okays 1997 water payments.

text.p: Directors of California's Metropolitan Water District on Tuesday authorised $311 million in payments to the state Department of Water Resources for 1997 water deliveries.

The Department of Water Resources owns and operates the state water project system of dams, reservoirs, power plants and aqueducts, delivering water to the San Francisco Bay area and southern California.
The $310.5 million payments would primarily cover the district's portion of fixed operating and capital costs for the giant water project, the Metropolitan Water District said.
The Metropolitan Water District is a regional water agency that imports water from northern California and the Colorado River for southern Californians.

Through its 27 member agencies, the district provides almost 60 percent of the water used by nearly 16 million people living in portions of Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, San Diego and Ventura counties.
